name: Iwase Kaori
source:
She works at a supermarket about three days a week.
She is getting a bit chubby, but looks younger than her age .
She's in her late 30s and wants to have child due to her age, but she doesn't tell her husband.

[Translated from the [url=http://www.hs-crowd.co.jp/anim/product/pro_pc/pc068/introduce.html#character]official website[/url]]
